# Neologisms {.unnumbered}

::: {#refs}
:::

The book does not coin any words of its own. Chapters are called *parandë* "(school) lesson", a Neo-Quenya word recorded in [Eldamo](https://eldamo.org/content/words/word-1387298955.html?neo) (from *par-* "to learn"), which replaced our earlier coinage *carincë*. Every word marked **NQ.** in the word lists is a neologism from Eldamo, which names its author and explains how it was formed.

If a future chapter needs a word that neither Tolkien nor Eldamo provides, it will be listed here with its formation and the Eldamo entries it is built from.
